text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, the enka contest...
I-I absolutely must make it a success...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It all started on the way back to the academy
after an outing with Sakura Chiyono O—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Chiyonoo-san!
Would you be willing to enter the "Umamusume Enka Contest"!?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It was an event for senior citizens...
and one person had to pull out due to an injury.
That's when—
choice_data_list: Just so happened we were passing by, you see.
Just say we happened to be passing by.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san... you often hum
soulful enka songs with such great vibrato, don't you!
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Awawa, oh, n-no... I'm so flattered!
I've really only dabbled a little in enka, so...
...But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"A bitter pill to swallow, but it only takes a furlong."
The brave first step is what matters most in everything...
...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Chiyono O ended up
participating in the enka contest, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhhhhaaahhh~~~♪
My love is swaaallooowed by the wiiind~~~
Vaaniishiing into the daaark waaaves~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Kita-chan...!
My heart just won't stop pounding!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
The vocal ornamentation and vibrato are just sublime...
Ah, I really am getting old... The tears are—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Uuugh~~ Going on stage makes me so nervous... B-But still...! For the play with Opera O-san, I have to find my courageee...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah~~~!
May this snow~~ gently envelop youuu~~âª

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man B
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Doto-chaaaan!!
Your delicate voice is lovely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Haaah... Everyone was so incredible...
I was totally entranced listening to them... but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to sing after this, right?
...W-What should I do...? My hands are... shaking...!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now, a formidable runner who even impressed Kitasan Black!
Here comes Sakura Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(W-Wah, I have to sing well, too...
Umm, umm...
How am I supposed to sing enka well again?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is trembling all by herself.
However, there's no need to worry.
She's a girl with immense courage—
choice_data_list: "Bitter to the mouth, but swift across a furlong"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... I don't have time to hesitate...
First... open my mouth...
and take that very first step—!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-The clouds are... thin and---

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaahhhhh♪
The waning mooon is your adoratiooon~!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man A
text_block_list.text:
Oh!?
What a deeply heartfelt way to sing!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...!
I can feel it!
Her straight, unyielding purity...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah~~~!
O valiant cherry blossoms of the night~~
Can you hear my feelings reaching out to youuu~~âª

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhhhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahhhhhh~~~~~~.
Somehow... somehow we got through it in one pieceeee.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san! I was so moved!
Your feelings... they hit me like a *BAM*!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "M-My heart feels so warm, too...! Chiyono O-san's singing voice was so soothing and lovely."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! No way, no way!
Compared to the two of you, someone like me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone... thank you so much!
My face feels so hot... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still—the reason I was able to sing properly
was all thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just when I was panicking about what to do,
I heard a voice... and that's when I realized!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're alone on stage, you're not truly alone.
There are people supporting you and watching over you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So――let's sing with that gratitude in our hearts!
choice_data_list: I can feel your heart coming through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Ehehe.
I'd love to participate in the Umamusume Enka Contest again.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Are you doing an encore?!
—That's great! Encore, encore!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...?
choice_data_list: It's proof that everyone's singing was fantastic.
That's proof that everyone's singing was fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa... W-Will it be okay...?
A sudden encore...
Will it go welllll...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! Because...
'Even bitter medicine starts from a single furlong'!
...Right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! First, one furlong!
Let's pool our strength together
and give it our all for the encore! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh♪
O-Oohhh~!
